mintAuthority.summary: D14 review 2026-10-03: verified SUDC.issueFromWrapper(address,uint256) checks only MINTER_ROLE and nominal MAX_SUPPLY, without requiring hUSDC/USDC deposits. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can grant MINTER_ROLE to a recipient-controlled account. The immutable one-billion nominal cap is not an economic backing bound. Whole-supply reserve reconciliation is unestablished.

controls.label: HedgeCore hUSDC wrapper contract (MINTER_ROLE holder)
controls.capDescription: MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant (≈1B tokens); issueFromWrapper() requires MINTER_ROLE and checks MAX_SUPPLY.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x34eea40fb819bfc762b836dd6269f975227794d3) returned true. wrapper() on sUSD returns the same address, cross-confirming the on-chain wrapper. eth_getCode on 0x34eea… returned 5674-byte contract. MAX_SUPPLY() = 1B tokens (immutable Solidity constant, no setter).

controls.label: HedgeCore DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (EOA)
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x30829883394adfc36f95a84881be1254f60bdd35) returned true. Also confirmed as wrapper() owner(). eth_getCode on 0x30829… returned empty bytecode (EOA). This EOA can grantRole/revokeRole to change the wrapper minter.

controls.label: HedgeCore operator (USDC deposit / Venus strategy / redemption)
controls.evidence: HedgeCore docs describe an operator running USDC deposit, Venus lending strategy, and operator-controlled early redemption; wrapper mint is gated behind this operator-controlled flow.

review.evidence: At BSC block 103632643: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, wrapper 0x34eea40fb...) = true; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, EOA 0x30829883...) = true; wrapper() = 0x34eea40fb... (confirmed cross-match). The admin has empty bytecode. MAX_SUPPLY() is an immutable one-billion-token constant. D14 review 2026-10-03 established that issueFromWrapper(address,uint256) checks only MINTER_ROLE and that nominal cap, without requiring hUSDC/USDC deposits; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can grant MINTER_ROLE to another account. The earlier bounded-economics inference is superseded. Correction researched 2026-10-20, without renewing the original review pin: the cited wrapper and yield documentation establish conversion and lending mechanics, not continuous reconciliation of all outstanding sUSD claims to gross strategy assets. The analytics documentation distinguishes cumulative totalUSDCDeposited from contractUSDCBalance and totalSupply; it does not publish a complete current strategy inventory or a reconciled reserve-to-liability denominator. Reconciliation is unknown, not none. No prudential supervisor or independent financial attestor is identified. The separately established unbounded native mint authority is retained.

sources.label: HedgeCore analytics: cumulative deposits are not current backing (retrieved 2026-10-20)
